newsitem.title: UK: NTT in talks with CGE - source.
newsitem.headline: NTT in talks with CGE - source.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp is in talks with France's Cie Gnrale des Eaux about taking a 9.9 percent stake in the company's joint, long-distance venture, Telecom Development.
"Generale des Eaux is in talks with NTT," a source close to the French company told Reuters in London.

Generale des Eaux is the majority shareholder in Cegetel, France's second telecoms operator in which British Telecommunications Plc is buying a 25 percent stake. CGE has been chosen by France's state-owned railway system, Societe Nationale des Chemins de Fer (SNCF), as its partner to deliver telecoms services over the railway's fibre-optic network, giving CGE's unit Cegetel a head start in a race to supply telecoms services as the French market opens up to competition in 1998.

Cegetel is taking a 40 percent stake in SNCF's new subsidiary, called Telecom Development. But Cegetel may bring in another partner to take its stake up to 49.9 percent, the source said. SNCF will hang onto its 50 percent stake.

Talks with other potential minority partners are also taking place, the source said, adding: "It is quite possible that nothing happens for a year." He declined to divulge how much the stakes in Telecom Development were worth.
